prompt: `tail -F /var/log/app.log | jq` crashes the logger process because a single line can exceed 1 MB. Fix the log writer to split messages above 128 KB into continuation lines with a stable sequence marker.
rubric: 5/5 if: no line written is larger than 128 KB, continuation markers parse deterministically, JSON-line readers survive across the split, and an existing slow consumer is not disconnected by the change.
